excluded.why: PasarPolis's own about page says the three unicorns funded its 2018 Series A — an investment event, not a current holding. No filing states anyone's present stake, so no ownership edge is drawn.

excluded.why: The carrying document is Grab Holdings' 20-F on sec.gov, and sec.gov refuses every fetch from this server — the claim could not be re-proven daily by the verifier, so it is withheld until a fetchable document carries it. The OVO–Grab payment relationship is published instead, from Grab's own terms.

excluded.why: tiket.com's own info pages reportedly name them, but tiket.com returns 403 to the verifier from this server, so the probes cannot be proven or re-proven. Withheld.

fas-fulfillment.name: FAS (Fulfillment at Speed)
fas-fulfillment.note: Fulfilment and business-enabler arm of the Blibli group — not a census row itself. The identity FAS = PT Global Distribusi Pusaka is stated in FAS's own terms & conditions; the same entity appears in Blibli's consolidated filing as a 99.99% subsidiary.

tiktok-nusantara.name: TikTok (TikTok Nusantara)
tiktok-nusantara.note: ByteDance-group Singapore entity that acquired the newly issued PT Tokopedia shares in January 2024, taking majority control (75.01%) of Tokopedia; named by legal entity in GoTo's audited FY2024 consolidated FS.

buka-mitra-indonesia.name: Buka Mitra Indonesia (Mitra Bukalapak)
buka-mitra-indonesia.note: 100%-owned direct subsidiary of PT Bukalapak.com Tbk operating the Mitra Bukalapak O2O warung platform — the core of Bukalapak's post-2025 business. Named 'PT. Buka Mitra Indonesia' / 'BMI' on Bukalapak's live help-centre pages and in the group's subsidiary table; likely to recur as future veins map warung-economy suppliers and partners onto Mitra Bukalapak.

sea-limited.name: Sea Limited
sea-limited.note: Parent of the Shopee, Monee (ex-SeaMoney) and Garena businesses; named 'Pemegang saham akhir / Ultimate shareholder' of PT Bank Seabank Indonesia in SeaBank's FY2025 annual report. Its FY2025 Form 20-F (sec.gov, accession 0001140361-26-015366) confirms PT Shopee International Indonesia as wholly-owned and lists PT Bank SeaBank Indonesia and PT Nusantara Ekspres Kilat in Exhibit 8.1, but www.sec.gov 403s the verifier UA from this VM.

spx-express.name: SPX Express
spx-express.note: Shopee-branded courier in Indonesia (Sea-group logistics arm; same ultimate shareholder as SeaBank per SeaBank AR 2025, and listed in Sea Ltd 20-F Exhibit 8.1). Its own site never names Shopee in verifier-reachable text, so no SPX->Shopee logistics edge is claimed yet.

emtek.name: Emtek
emtek.note: IDX-listed (EMTK) media/tech conglomerate of the Sariaatmadja family; parent of SCTV/Indosiar broadcaster SCMA, Vidio (via SCM), Kreatif Media Karya, and — since Feb 2025 — controlling owner of Bukalapak.

multipolar.name: Multipolar
multipolar.note: IDX-listed (MLPL) Lippo-group investment holding; parent of PT Matahari Putra Prima, PT Multipolar Technology Tbk, and PT Visionet Data Internasional (VisioNet).

amrt.name: Alfamart (Sumber Alfaria Trijaya)
amrt.note: IDX-listed (AMRT) operator of the Alfamart minimarket chain; parent of PT Global Loyalty Indonesia, which runs the Alfagift loyalty program.

bca.name: BCA
bca.note: Indonesia's largest private bank (IDX: BBCA); recurring RDN/settlement bank for census brokers and investment apps (Stockbit, Bibit).

astra-financial.name: Astra Financial
astra-financial.note: Financial-services arm of PT Astra International Tbk; 49.62% co-owner of census digital bank Bank Saqu (PT Bank Saqu Indonesia).

jne.name: JNE
jne.note: National courier. Already in the graph twice as a bare name (JNE -> blibli [logistics], JNE -> shipper [aggregation]) — those should be rewired to this slug. Identity bridge: its own homepage names the PT in visible text.

sap-express.name: SAP Express (SAPX)
sap-express.note: IDX-listed courier (ticker SAPX), COD/B2B specialist. Already in the graph once as bare name (SAP Express -> shipper [aggregation]) — should be rewired to this slug. Identity bridge on its own homepage; annual reports hosted at www.sapx.id.

chubb-indonesia.name: Chubb Indonesia
chubb-indonesia.note: Indonesian general-insurance arm of Chubb; underwrites Traveloka's flight, hotel and train travel insurance (cooperation since Dec 2015). Legal entity named in Chubb's own media-room release.

aws.name: Amazon Web Services (AWS)
aws.note: Hyperscale cloud provider; named in Superbank's IPO prospectus as its cloud provider (financial services enterprise agreement, 17 Mar 2023).

polytron.name: Polytron
polytron.note: Indonesian consumer-electronics and e-motorcycle manufacturer (Kudus); same ultimate shareholder (Djarum/Hartono) as Blibli. polytron.co.id's own schema.org Organization block names the maker as 'PT. Hartono Istana Teknologi' (identity bridge).

google-cloud.name: Google Cloud
google-cloud.note: Google's Indonesian cloud entity; Elitery's FY2025 FS names it as its only supplier above 10% (resale partner since Oct 2020). Also already on the graph as a bare name supplying Bukalapak (existing edge 'PT Google Cloud Indonesia -> bukalapak').

diva.name: DIVA (Distribusi Voucher Nusantara)
diva.note: IDX-listed digital-voucher and Smart Outlet distributor; holds 30% of Pawoon (PT Alphanovation Digital Teknindo) as an associate since 2019.

dci-indonesia.name: DCI Indonesia
dci-indonesia.note: Listed Indonesian colocation data-centre operator (Cibitung/JK campuses). SeaBank's FY2025 FS names it as a dedicated-colocation provider (DCI JK3); DCI's own FS names Cikarang Listrindo as its only >10% supplier (electricity).

formosa-ingredient-factory.name: Boba King (Formosa Ingredient Factory)
formosa-ingredient-factory.note: IDX-listed maker of tapioca pearls, syrups, premium sauces, jellies and premix powders for drink chains (Boba King brand); its audited FS lists Haus! and Kopi Kenangan's operating companies among its trade debtors.

cosmax-indonesia.name: Cosmax Indonesia
cosmax-indonesia.note: Korean-owned cosmetics ODM/OEM with a factory in Indonesia; BPOM lists it as the manufacturing plant (Industri Kosmetika) for 3,700+ notified products across many local brands, incl. SOMETHINC and ESQA.

shanghai-ayara-cosmetics.name: Shanghai Ayara Cosmetics
shanghai-ayara-cosmetics.note: Chinese colour-cosmetics OEM; BPOM names it the manufacturer of imported SOMETHINC and ESQA make-up (brow, concealer, blush, palettes). Sister plant in Indonesia appears in BPOM as "Ayara Beauty Indonesia".

eyecos-kosmetik-indonesia.name: Eyecos Kosmetik Indonesia
eyecos-kosmetik-indonesia.note: Indonesian cosmetics plant (BPOM manufacturer ID MAZA-M60910); fills, packs and makes SOMETHINC lip and brow products. Name matches Ningbo Eyecos Cosmetic Co., Ltd, which BPOM also lists as a SOMETHINC maker (15 notifications); affiliation inferred from the name only.

cedefindo.name: Cedefindo
cedefindo.note: Indonesian cosmetics contract manufacturer (BPOM manufacturer ID MAZA-M20); makes ESQA lipsticks and liquid blush.

nayue-biotech-indonesia.name: Nayue Biotech Indonesia
nayue-biotech-indonesia.note: Indonesian cosmetics plant (BPOM manufacturer IDs MAZA-M62069 / MAZA-M63298); makes ESQA and SOMETHINC lip products. PT Nayue Kosmetik Indonesia, a same-name registrant, notifies further ESQA and BASE products on the brands' behalf (group link inferred from the name).

neo-kosmetika-industri.name: Neo Kosmetika Industri
neo-kosmetika-industri.note: Indonesian cosmetics contract manufacturer (BPOM manufacturer ID MAZA-M1); makes SOMETHINC ACNEDOT skincare.

genero-pharmaceuticals.name: Genero Pharmaceuticals
genero-pharmaceuticals.note: Indonesian skincare maklon; registers and manufactures BASE serums and sunscreens under its own notification.

devindo-surya-amora.name: Devindo Surya Amora
devindo-surya-amora.note: Indonesian cosmetics maklon; manufactures the BASE products that PT Basis Inovasi Global notifies itself, plus BASE Centamide Gentle Hydrating Cleanser.

meiyume-manufacturing-indonesia.name: Meiyume Manufacturing Indonesia
meiyume-manufacturing-indonesia.note: Indonesian beauty-products plant (BPOM manufacturer); the largest maker of the locally produced lines that Social Bella notifies in its own name (FLUORA, GEMISTRY, IN THE MOOD FOR, CARASUN, &GEMME).

kurniamitra-duta-sentosa.name: Kurniamitra Duta Sentosa (KMDS)
kurniamitra-duta-sentosa.note: Food-service ingredient distributor: its >10% suppliers are Monin Asia (MONIN syrups), related party PT Formosa Ingredient Factory Tbk (Bobaking) and Chatime HK; also sells coffee machines and spare parts (FY2025 net sales note). Sells into coffee chains, QSR and modern retail.

monin-asia.name: MONIN (Monin Asia)
monin-asia.note: Asian hub of the French syrup maker MONIN; KMDS's largest supplier (tier-2 behind the coffee chains KMDS serves).

cansino-biologics.name: CanSino Biologics
cansino-biologics.note: Chinese vaccine maker; Etana's "global partner" for the MCV4 meningococcal conjugate vaccine Menhycia (imported finished vaccine) and a collaboration partner on an inhalable TB vaccine.

walvax-biotechnology.name: Walvax Biotechnology
walvax-biotechnology.note: Chinese vaccine maker; mRNA vaccine development partner of Etana (with RNACure) under a July 2023 collaboration agreement.

hon-chuan-indonesia.name: Hon Chuan Indonesia
hon-chuan-indonesia.note: Beverage co-packer filling PET bottles in Indonesia; produces Kopi Kenangan's ready-to-drink bottled coffee. (Name matches Taiwan's Hon Chuan Enterprise group; affiliation not verified in these sources.)

diamond-cold-storage.name: Diamond Cold Storage
diamond-cold-storage.note: Indonesian dairy/food manufacturer (Diamond brand); produces TOMORO-branded barista UHT milk. (Believed to belong to PT Diamond Food Indonesia Tbk, whose distributor PT Sukanda Jaya already supplies Fore; affiliation not verified in these sources.)

kalista.name: KALISTA (Indika Energy EV fleet-as-a-service)
kalista.note: Indika Energy's commercial-EV leasing and charging-infrastructure arm (INDY AR2025). Leases ALVA fleets to Dash Electric; buys ALVA motorcycles; charging partnership with Voltron.

vmoto.name: Vmoto (Super Soco)
vmoto.note: Chinese-Australian electric two-wheeler maker; Charged Asia's core technology partner and battery/vehicle supplier, paid in Charged Asia equity (8%).

dfsk-indonesia.name: DFSK
dfsk-indonesia.note: Maker of the Gelora E electric van used in Dash Electric's fleet. Indonesian entity not named in the cited page (commonly PT Sokonindo Automobile; unverified here).

manufaktur-kreasi-bangsa.name: Manufaktur Kreasi Bangsa (MKB)
manufaktur-kreasi-bangsa.note: Electrum's in-group assembly company (held through PT Energi Kreasi Bersama per TBS AR2025).

berau-coal.name: Berau Coal
berau-coal.note: Coal miner; SUN Energy's largest customer (17.71% of FY2025 revenue).

indocement.name: Indocement
indocement.note: Cement maker; SUN Energy builds and runs the 32.5 MW Citeureup solar plant.

tjiwi-kimia.name: Tjiwi Kimia
tjiwi-kimia.legal: PT Pabrik Kertas Tjiwi Kimia Tbk
tjiwi-kimia.note: Paper maker (APP / Sinar Mas); 9.8 MWp SUN Energy rooftop solar per SUN project page.

indah-kiat.name: Indah Kiat Pulp & Paper
indah-kiat.legal: PT Indah Kiat Pulp & Paper Tbk
indah-kiat.note: Pulp and paper maker (APP / Sinar Mas); SUN Energy solar-utilisation customer.

astra-honda-motor.name: Astra Honda Motor
astra-honda-motor.note: Motorcycle manufacturer; SUN Energy rooftop solar at its Cikarang production facility.

kia-keramik.name: KIA Keramik
kia-keramik.note: Ceramic tile manufacturer; 3.1 MWp SUN Energy rooftop solar at its Karawang factory.

sido-muncul.name: Sido Muncul
sido-muncul.legal: PT Industri Jamu dan Farmasi Sido Muncul Tbk
sido-muncul.note: Herbal-medicine manufacturer (Tolak Angin); 2 MWp SUN Energy rooftop solar in Semarang.

muliaglass.name: Muliaglass
muliaglass.note: Glass manufacturer in the Mulia Industri complex, Cikarang; 22.5 MW Xurya rooftop solar shared with PT Muliakeramik Indahraya.

muliakeramik.name: Muliakeramik
muliakeramik.note: Ceramic-tile manufacturer in the Mulia Industri complex, Cikarang.

uni-charm-indonesia.name: Uni-Charm Indonesia
uni-charm-indonesia.note: Diaper and hygiene-products manufacturer; 12 MWp across 3 factories inaugurated with Xurya as installation partner.

softex-indonesia.name: Kimberly-Clark Softex
softex-indonesia.note: Hygiene-products manufacturer (Kimberly-Clark JV); Xurya rooftop solar at its Sidoarjo factory.

arwana-citramulia.name: Arwana Ceramics
arwana-citramulia.note: Ceramic-tile manufacturer; Xurya rooftop solar (4,554 panels) at its Mojokerto plant PL5.

bungasari.name: Bungasari
bungasari.note: Wheat-flour miller; 2.4 MWp Xurya rooftop solar at its Medan mill.

saranacentral-bajatama.name: Saranacentral Bajatama
saranacentral-bajatama.note: Galvalume steel-sheet maker; Xurya rooftop solar at its Karawang plant (2,160 panels).

solusi-bangun-indonesia.name: Solusi Bangun Indonesia (SBI)
solusi-bangun-indonesia.note: Cement maker (SIG group); BTI Energy installed 1.17 MWp on-grid solar at its Tuban plant.

emits.name: EMITS (Indika solar)
emits.legal: PT Empat Mitra Indika Tenaga Surya
emits.note: Indika Energy's rooftop-solar company (51% per INDY AR2025); runs the 7.015 MWp PLTS at HM Sampoerna's Pasuruan facility, maintained by BTI Energy.

gogoro.name: Gogoro
gogoro.note: Taiwanese Smartscooter and battery-swapping (GoStation) maker; supplied the Gojek pilot and the Electrum commercial trial.

gesits.name: Gesits
gesits.note: Indonesian electric-motorcycle brand; its EVs were part of the Electrum/Gojek commercial trial. Legal entity not named in the cited page.

pertamina-patra-niaga.name: Pertamina Patra Niaga
pertamina-patra-niaga.note: Pertamina downstream fuel retailer (SPBU network); hosts a co-branded Starvo SPKLU at SPBU Pertamina Fatmawati under a PKS.

hyundai.name: Hyundai
hyundai.note: Hyundai Motor; IONIQ Electric cars run as GrabCar Elektrik from Soekarno-Hatta airport (Jan 2020). Indonesian entity not named in the cited page.

gac.name: GAC (AION)
gac.note: Chinese carmaker; strategic deal for an initial 20,000 EVs (AION Y, ES, V) for Grab driver-partners across six SEA markets incl. Indonesia (Jan 2026).

kalbe-farma.name: Kalbe Farma
kalbe-farma.note: Indonesia's largest listed pharmaceutical group; plants run serialization and automation systems built by census industrial-automation firms.

dexa-medica.name: Dexa Medica (Dexa Group)
dexa-medica.note: Dexa Group's pharmaceutical manufacturer (Cikarang/Palembang plants); Dexa Group also runs the census healthtech Global Urban Esensial (GoApotik).

hm-sampoerna.name: HM Sampoerna
hm-sampoerna.note: Largest listed tobacco manufacturer (Philip Morris International affiliate); its Karawang and Sukorejo plants run RFID tracking and robot palletizing systems from a census automation firm.

astra-otoparts.name: Astra Otoparts
astra-otoparts.note: Astra group's automotive-component manufacturer; runs a material-flow track-and-trace system built by a census automation firm.

bintang-toedjoe.name: Bintang Toedjoe
bintang-toedjoe.note: Kalbe group consumer-health and energy-drink maker (Extra Joss, Komix); its plants run automation from two census industrial-automation firms (Nagamas, JT Auto).

epson.name: Epson
epson.note: Japanese printer maker whose TM-series thermal receipt/kitchen printers are sold in the POS hardware shops of census POS companies (Pawoon, Moka/GoTo).

sumi-rubber-indonesia.name: Sumi Rubber Indonesia (Dunlop)
sumi-rubber-indonesia.note: Sumitomo Rubber's Dunlop tyre plant in Indonesia; runs tyre-conveyor and AI inspection systems built by two census industrial-automation firms (Nagamas, Ravelware).

telkom-neucentrix.name: Telkom neuCentrIX (NeutraDC)
telkom-neucentrix.note: Telkom Group data-centre brand (neuCentrIX, now under NeutraDC); POP/colocation site for census hosting providers

nex-datacenter.name: NexCenter (NEX Data Center, Menara Tendean)
nex-datacenter.note: Tier 3 certified data centre at Menara Tendean, Jakarta; named by Qwords as one of its data-centre locations

cikarang-listrindo.name: Cikarang Listrindo
cikarang-listrindo.note: Private power producer in the Cikarang industrial area; supplies electricity to DCI Indonesia data centres (tier-2: DCI hosts census cloud providers)

idc-duren-tiga.name: IDC Duren Tiga
idc-duren-tiga.note: Carrier-neutral data-centre complex at Duren Tiga, South Jakarta; named by Klikserver as one of its data-centre sites

cyber-1-building.name: Cyber 1 Building
cyber-1-building.note: Jakarta carrier hotel / data-centre building at Jl. Kuningan Barat 8 (APJII IX hub); houses census hosting providers servers

equinix.name: Equinix
equinix.note: Global colocation operator; SG1 Singapore hosts Herza Cloud Singapore POP
